title: Manifest
description: Inventory of every shipped data file (web/public/data/manifest.json). Sources are cited per file, so there is no top-level source_urls.

files.description: One entry per shipped file, excluding manifest.json itself.

path.description: Path relative to web/public/data/ with forward slashes (no units), e.g. masks/shackleton-rim.json.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file contents as 64 lower-case hex characters (no units).
